interactive.label: Export .npy
interactive.tooltip: Save the computed volume as a NumPy array at full float precision, without metadata. Greyed until a volume exists.

interactive.label: Export .tif
interactive.tooltip: Save the computed volume as a 32-bit ImageJ TIFF stack that carries the voxel size, so ImageJ scales it correctly. Greyed until a volume exists.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tool.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the optical models, the polarization and how to read the volume.

interactive.label: na
interactive.tooltip: Numerical aperture. Above about 1.0 the scalar models stop being trustworthy and the vectorial one should be used.

interactive.label: n_immersion
interactive.tooltip: Refractive index of the immersion medium: 1.518 oil, 1.33 water, 1.0 air. The NA cannot exceed it.

interactive.label: wavelength_nm
interactive.tooltip: Emission or excitation wavelength in nanometres.

interactive.label: angle_deg
interactive.tooltip: Orientation of the linear state, measured from the x axis. Used only when Polarization is 'Linear at angle'.

interactive.label: nxy
interactive.tooltip: Pixels per lateral side of the volume.

interactive.label: nz
interactive.tooltip: Number of axial planes, centred on focus.

interactive.label: pixel_size_nm
interactive.tooltip: Lateral sampling in nanometres.

interactive.label: z_step_nm
interactive.tooltip: Axial spacing between planes.

interactive.label: threshold
interactive.tooltip: Hide voxels below this fraction of the peak. A diffraction-limited focus is mostly empty space and renders as fog without it.

interactive.label: gamma
interactive.tooltip: Shapes the opacity ramp. Below 1 lifts the faint wings into view.

interactive.label: Polarization vectors
interactive.tooltip: Draw the pupil polarization state as strokes on a ring above the focus. Vectorial model only, since the scalar models ignore polarization.
